wiki.title: Sandscale Scavenger
wiki.text:
The Sandscale Scavenger is an enemy manguana NPC that can be found in Sunstone Valley.

Drops
Once defeated, there is a chance to receive the following items:
Coins
Blast Spheres
Flabbergast Spheres
Manguana Tribal Necklace
Cloth Wraps

Appearances
Sunstone Valley
Sandscale Oasis
